NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription.en: To add your upcoming sessions to a “ChamaFit” calendar and rebuild it when you change your routine.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription.ca: Per posar les teves properes sessions en un calendari «ChamaFit» i refer-lo quan canvies la rutina.

NSCameraUsageDescription.en: To scan the barcode of what you eat and log it.
NSCameraUsageDescription.ca: Per escanejar el codi de barres del que menges i apuntar-ho.

NSHealthShareUsageDescription.en: ChamaFit reads your heart rate, sleep, steps and weight to show your recovery, and the calories of workouts recorded on your Apple Watch.
NSHealthShareUsageDescription.ca: ChamaFit llegeix el teu ritme cardíac, son, passes i pes per mostrar la teva recuperació, i les calories dels entrenaments que registra l’Apple Watch.

NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription.en: ChamaFit saves each session as a strength workout in Health, plus your weight and water.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription.ca: ChamaFit desa cada sessió com a entrenament de força a Salut, a més del teu pes i l’aigua.

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.en: To log your sets by voice in workout mode (“80 kilos for 8”). Audio is not stored.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.ca: Per apuntar les sèries parlant en el mode entrenament («80 quilos per 8»). L’àudio no es desa.

NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.en: To understand what you say in workout mode. Whenever possible, it’s recognised on your iPhone.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription.ca: Per entendre el que dius en el mode entrenament. Sempre que es pot, es reconeix al mateix iPhone.
